story.p1: I-{{full}} yathoma ngesikhathi sokuziqhenya. U-{{founder}} wabona umngani wakhe aseduze athoma ikampani yakhe, esebenza khulu ngeensizo zokuthengisa, begodu wazibonela bona kutlhogeka isibindi esingangani ukuthoma.
story.p2: Isikhathesi sahlala naye. Kade athanda ukusiza ama-SMME bona afikelele imigomo yawo, athuthuke begodu akhule, begodu bekafuna ukwakha into ezokuma nawo nawenza lokho.
story.p3: Ibizo mlayezo ebekafuna ukuwuthumela kumngani wakhe, nakiwo woke amabhizinisi neenhlangano ezilisebenzisako: niyakghona. Ragelani phambili nilwela, ningakhe niyeme.
story.title: Indaba yethu

about.tagline: I-CRM ehlanganisa ibhizinisi lakho, amakhasimende wakho nesiqhema sakho.

channels.mailboxIntro: Hlanganisa ibhoksi elifanako othumela ngalo. I-YGT ilihlola qobe mzuzu begodu ifaka iimpendulo zamakhasimende eenkulumiswaneni zawo. Ayisusi namkha ayitshwayi ama-imeyili wakho njengafundiweko.
channels.smsIntro: Thumela begodu wamukele ama-SMS nge-akhawunti yakho kumhlinzeki we-SMS. Ubhadela umhlinzeki ngqo ngemilayezo.

smsSteps.account: Vula i-akhawunti ku-BulkSMS, Clickatell namkha Twilio bese uthenga ikhredithi.
smsSteps.keys: Yenza iinkhiya ze-API edetjhibhodini yomhlinzeki bese uzinamathisela ngaphasi.
smsSteps.sender: Engeza i-ID yomthumeli namkha inomboro evunyelwe mhlinzeki wakho (amanethiwekhi amanengi weSewula Afrika atlhoga i-ID yomthumeli etloliswe).
smsSteps.webhook: Bulunga, hlola ngenomboro yakho, bese ubeka i-webhook URL etjengiswe ngaphasi njengekheli le-SMS engenako lomhlinzeki.

webhookHelp.sms: Edetjhibhodini yomhlinzeki wakho we-SMS, beka lokhu njengekheli lemilayezo engenako (inbound / reply webhook) bona iimpendulo zifike ku-YGT.
webhookHelp.whatsapp: Namathisela lokhu ku-Meta: WhatsApp > Configuration > Webhook, bese utlolisela "messages". Yindlela iimpendulo zamakhasimende ezifika ngayo ku-YGT.

channels.whatsappIntro: Hlanganisa inomboro yakho ye-WhatsApp Business nge-Cloud API esemthethweni ye-Meta. Imilayezo iphuma enomborweni yakho begodu iimpendulo zingena ku-Imilayezo.

whatsappSteps.app: Iya ku-developers.facebook.com, yenza i-app yohlobo lwe-Business bese wengeza umkhiqizo we-WhatsApp.
whatsappSteps.ids: Ngaphasi kwe-WhatsApp > API Setup, engeza inomboro yomtato yebhizinisi lakho bese ukopa i-Phone number ID ne-WhatsApp Business Account ID.
whatsappSteps.save: Kunamathisele ngaphasi, tshwaya "Sebenzisa i-WhatsApp", bulunga, bese uhlola ngenomboro yakho yeselula.
whatsappSteps.token: Ku-Business Settings > System users, yenza i-access token ehlala njalo enemvumo ye-whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsappSteps.webhook: Kopa i-webhook URL ne-verify token okutjengiswa ngemva kokubulunga eenlungiselelweni ze-webhook ze-Meta.
whatsappSteps.window: Umthetho we-WhatsApp: ungaphendula ngokukhululeka amawura ama-24 ngemva kobana ikhasimende likuthumelele umlayezo; ukuthoma ikulumiswano ngemva kwalokho kutlhoga i-template evunyelwe yi-Meta.

common.loadError: Asikghonanga ukulayitsha lokhu. Hlola ukuthintana kwakho bese ulinga godu.

activities.a1: Vula isivumelwano namkha ikhasimende bese uqhwarhaza u-Hlela, namkha usebenzise imisebenzi erhabako (Ikhwalo, I-imeyili, Umhlangano) ngaphezulu ekhasini labo.
activities.a2: Asinawo umsebenzi ovulekileko. Iinvumelwano ezingenagadango elilandelako zivamise ukuphola, ngalokho hlela linye.

activities.p2: Tjhugulula phakathi kwemisebenzi yakho neyawo woke umuntu
activities.p3: Inomboro ebomvu kumenyu ibala okudlulelwe sikhathi namkha okufanele namhlanje

charts.p2: Imali ebuthelelweko: iimbhadelo ezamukelweko inyanga ngayinye
charts.p3: Iinkolodo: okusesele nokobana kungangani okudlulelwe sikhathi

dashboard.a1: Ziyazala njengombana wengeza iinvumelwano begodu utlola iimbhadelo. Izinga lokuphumelela litlhoga okungenani isivumelwano esisodwa esiphumeleleko namkha esilahlekileko.
dashboard.a2: Iye. Qhwarhaza nanyana yiyiphi inomboro namkha isihloko sephaneli bona uvule irhelo elingemva kwayo.
dashboard.p1: Iinomboro eziqakathekileko: iphayiphi evulekileko, iinvumelwano eziphumeleleko kunyanga le, izinga lokuphumelela nobukhulu besivumelwano obujayelekileko
dashboard.p2: Amatjhadi: ibalelo lephayiphi ngesigaba nemali ebuthelelweko ngeenyangeni ezisithandathu
dashboard.p3: Ilanga lakho: iingcingo, imihlangano nemisebenzi efaneleko namhlanje namkha edlulelwe sikhathi
dashboard.p4: Imali okweledwa yona, iinvumelwano zakho ezikulu ezivulekileko nemisebenzi yakwanje
dashboard.summary: Isikrini sakho sekhaya: bona ukuthengisa kukhamba njani, okufanele ukwenze namhlanje, nalokho okweledwa khona.
dashboard.title: Idetjhibhodi

deals.p3: Isivumelwano ngasinye sitjengisa ibalelo, umnikazi, ibubulo negadango elilandelako

marketing.a1: Amakhasimende asebenzako ane-imeyili angakazikhuphi. I-imeyili ngayinye inelinki yokuzikhupha, njengombana i-POPIA itlhoga.
marketing.p1: Imikhankaso enokubuka kokuthoma okuphilako, ukuthumela kokuhlola nokuhlela
marketing.p2: Abalaleli: amaqembu afana no-"bathenge emalangeni ama-90 wokugcina"
marketing.summary: Thumela amakhasimende wakho i-imeyili ngemikhiqizo emitja nokukhethekileko.
marketing.title: Ukurhwebisa

messages.a1: Nabaphendula i-imeyili yakho, WhatsApp namkha SMS, ipendulo yengezwa ekukhulumisaneni okufanako ngokuzenzakalela.
messages.a2: Umphathi wakho kufuze athome azihlanganise ku-Iinlungiselelo > WhatsApp ne-SMS.
messages.p1: Ithebhu lamakhasimende: koke ukukhulumisana, okutja kokuthoma, okungakafundwa kutshwayiwe
messages.p2: Phendula, namkha wengeze inothi langaphakathi elibonwa sisiqhema sakho kwaphela
messages.p3: Nikela umuntu ukukhulumisana bese ukuvala nakuphelile
messages.p4: Ithebhu lesiqhema: iinteshi zokukhulumisana zabasebenzi bakho
messages.q2: Kubayini ngingakghoni ukukhetha i-WhatsApp namkha i-SMS?
messages.summary: Ibhokisi linye le-imeyili, WhatsApp ne-SMS namakhasimende, kanye nokukhulumisana nesiqhema sakho.
messages.title: Imilayezo

products.a1: Vula umkhiqizo bese wengeza inani elikhethekileko nelanga lokuphela. Utjengisa ibheji le-Okukhethekileko bekudlule ilanga.
products.p2: Okukhethekileko okunelanga lokuphela, okutjengiswa kuma-imeyili wokurhwebisa
products.summary: Irhelo lakho lamanani. Imikhiqizo ikuzalisela imigca yeenlinganiso nama-invoyisi.
products.title: Imikhiqizo

quotes.a1: Awa. Iinlinganiso ezithunyelweko zikhiyiwe bona woke umuntu abone into efanako. Esikhundleni salokho yenza isilinganiso esitja.
quotes.summary: Amanani owathumela amakhasimende ngaphambi kobana azibophe.
quotes.title: Iinlinganiso

search.summary: Fumana nanyana yiliphi ikhasimende, umuntu, isivumelwano, i-invoyisi namkha isilinganiso. Qhwarhaza u-Ctrl K nanyana kuphi.
search.title: Funa

settings.a1: Iinlungiselelo > Isiqhema. Nikela umuntu ngamunye indima nephasiwedi yesikhathana yokungena.
settings.p1: Okuvamileko: imininingwana yekampani, iinomboro, iinkhumbuzo namagama
settings.p2: Isiqhema: engeza abantu bese ukhetha abangakwenza
settings.p3: I-imeyili, WhatsApp ne-SMS: hlanganisa ama-akhawunti wakho
settings.summary: Abaphathi kwaphela: indlela ikampani yakho ehlelwe ngayo.
settings.title: Iinlungiselelo

purchaseOrders.title: Ama-oda wokuthenga
purchaseOrders.summary: Oda isitoko namasevisi kubathengisi bakho, ulandelele okufikileko.
purchaseOrders.p2: Irhelo labathengisi, ne-imeyili lapho i-oda ngalinye liya khona
purchaseOrders.p3: Izinto ezibulungiweko: layisha isiqhema semigca oyisebenzisa kanengi
purchaseOrders.a1: Inomboro ye-oda esilinganisweni namkha ku-invoyisi yinomboro yekhasimende lakho yalokho abakuthenga kuwe. I-oda lokuthenga lapha ngilokho okuthumela umthengisi wakho.
purchaseOrders.a2: Awa. Likhansele bese wenza elitjha, bona umthengisi wakho namarekhodi wakho ahlale ahambisana.

tour.supportBody: Faka ithikithi nawutlhoga isizo, ulandelele iimpendulo zethu, namkha ubhukhe ikholi yevidiyo nesiqhema se-YGT.
tour.helpBody: Iinqophiso zegadango ngegadango zesikrini soke. Ungabuyelela ikambo leli ukusuka lapho.
